faq.headline: Quick Answers Before You See It On Your Business

items.q: Do I have to replace CompanyCam or my CRM?
items.a: No. JobCapturePro can work alongside the systems you already use. Those tools document and manage the job. JCP helps turn completed work into public-facing marketing proof.

items.q: What does my crew actually have to do?
items.a: Capture the finished job. JobCapturePro handles the downstream proof workflow based on how your account is configured.

items.q: Do my technicians have to write marketing content?
items.a: No. They document the job. JobCapturePro creates usable content from the job information, photos and location.
Your website, Google Business Profile, social channels and JobCapturePro directory, depending on the channels you connect and enable.

items.q: Does JobCapturePro guarantee better Google rankings?
items.a: No. Rankings depend on many factors. JobCapturePro helps create fresh, real-world local proof that can support visibility and give homeowners more information when deciding who to call.
If JobCapturePro looks like a fit, you can get started whenever you're ready.
